name: decide
description: Present a decision between 2-5 options. Use 'select' mode for a simple pick (option cards). Use 'score' mode when the agent has done analysis and wants the human to verify a per-criterion scoring matrix — pre-fill every cell with a value, rationale, and citations. Cognitive op: decide.

description.description: 1-2 sentence context for why this decision matters now

findings.description: Score mode only. A short executive summary (3-6 lines) of the agent's analysis — the conclusion in plain prose. Optional but encouraged.

mode.description: 'select' = option cards, human picks one. 'score' = pre-scored matrix, human verifies the agent's analysis (every cell must be pre-filled with value + rationale).

scores.description: Score mode only. Required when mode='score'. Map of criterionId → cell. Every criterion must be present.

rationale.description: 1-2 sentence justification for the score. Cite specifics.

criteria.description: Required when mode is 'score'; optional context bullets when mode is 'select'.

scale_steps.description: Score-mode only. Number of points on the per-cell rating scale (1 to scale_steps).
